usagePolicy.rule: Consumers choose a registered component and pass documented props only. They must not add local CSS for a component or pass raw colors, spacing, radius, shadow, icon paths, or state styling.
usagePolicy.exceptions: Only component-specific geometry explicitly registered in COMPONENTS.md and the executable contract may differ from the Foundation scale.
